evals.prompt: I'm stopping for today. Write a handoff for the next session based on NOTES.md and the repo, and tell me where you saved it. Save it as handoff.md in /tmp/hs-eval-handoff/ (create the folder).
evals.check: test -s /tmp/hs-eval-handoff/handoff.md && test -z "$(git status --porcelain)" && grep -qi tomli /tmp/hs-eval-handoff/handoff.md && grep -qi 'env' /tmp/hs-eval-handoff/handoff.md; r=$?; rm -rf /tmp/hs-eval-handoff; exit $r
expectations: The check command exits 0 (handoff saved outside the repo, mentions tomli and the env var override)
The handoff records the failed approach (tomllib on Python 3.10) and why it failed
The handoff quotes or preserves the user's correction about keeping the env var override and lists the open items (docs/setup.md, removing the config.ini fallback after 2.4)

evals.prompt: Turn the correction in CONTEXT.md into a lesson the team can share. Draft it as lesson-draft.md in the repo root; don't commit.
evals.check: test -s lesson-draft.md && grep -q 'paths:' lesson-draft.md && grep -q 'src/billing' lesson-draft.md
expectations: The check command exits 0 (draft exists, path-scoped to src/billing)
The lesson states when it applies and when it doesn't (applicability bounds), not just a general rule
The lesson includes the concrete evidence (10.299999 / 10.29 vs 10.30, or the npm run invoices run) and marks its provenance as coming from the user

evals.prompt: Who calls charge()? List every call site.
expectations: The reply lists both call sites, src/cart.js and src/refund.js, with line references, and does not list src/other.js
